content.text: In today's digital economy, many creators in Zimbabwe are locked out of vital payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This situation leaves you with limited options for monetizing your work and serving your audience. COREMERCH presents a solution: building your own crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, allowing you to create a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-18|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure. With our Edge Commerce Stack, you will own your entire online store, circumventing the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms. This guide will take you through the deployment process step-by-step, ensuring you can start [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-you-12|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-every-detail-you-6|selling]] your digital products quickly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose geographical restrictions, leaving creators in regions like Zimbabwe unable to access essential services. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is built to overcome these barriers. By using Cloudflare Pages combined with cryptocurrency payment processing, you have a system that is not reliant on external platforms. You gain full control over your online store, from the payment layer to product delivery. This architecture prioritizes ownership and autonomy, allowing you to operate effectively in an environment where conventional services fail. The absence of KYC requirements with cryptocurrencies means you can engage in commerce without unnecessary hurdles. Ultimately, this infrastructure empowers you, offering a stable foundation for your digital business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you need a few essential tools and accounts to get started. Firstly, create a Cloudflare account to utilize their Pages service, which provides hosting for your store. Next, set up a GitHub account to manage your codebase and track changes effectively. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be pivotal for backend logic and automation. Additionally, you will need to register for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, ranging from ebooks to software. Lastly, gather your branding assets, including logos and product images, to create an appealing storefront. With these components in place, you're ready to begin the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your cloud frontend. This involves creating an account with NOWPayments and obtaining your API keys. Once you have your keys, configure your Google Apps Script backend to handle payment requests. This script will listen for transactions and handle webhook calls from NOWPayments to confirm payments. Next, choose your file delivery method. Options include using Google Drive for secure file storage or Cloudflare R2 for better performance. Upload your digital products to your chosen storage solution, ensuring access links are correctly configured. This setup will allow you to deliver products automatically upon successful payment confirmation, creating a seamless experience for your customers.
Take ownership of your digital sales today.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have configured your payment and delivery systems, it's time to go live. Deploy your application on Cloudflare Pages, ensuring all your components are correctly linked. Before officially launching, conduct thorough testing on the mainnet with a small transaction to verify that everything functions as expected. Look out for any issues with payment processing or file delivery. Once you are confident with the setup, promote your store to your audience. Utilize social media and other channels to drive traffic to your site. Upon receiving your first order, monitor the transaction closely and ensure the automated delivery process works flawlessly. This first transaction will validate your setup and give you confidence moving forward.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your crypto store up and running, focus on scaling your operations. Start by analyzing customer behavior and sales data to identify which products are most popular. This information will help you make informed decisions on inventory and marketing strategies. Consider expanding your product range to include more digital offerings that cater to your audience's needs. Additionally, optimize your pricing strategy based on market research and competitor analysis. Enhancing your marketing efforts through targeted ads or partnerships can also drive more traffic to your store. As your business grows, ensure your backend infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance. Continuous investment in your technology stack will help you maintain a competitive edge.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages is a straightforward process that allows you to bypass restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms. By utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, you gain access to seamless hosting, payment processing, and delivery mechanisms without relying on third-party platforms. This infrastructure grants you ownership and control over your sales process, enabling you to thrive in a digital economy constrained by traditional services.
No subscriptions. No KYC. Just pure commerce.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For a comprehensive solution to building your own crypto store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack priced at $197. This stack equips you with everything needed for a successful deployment, allowing you to harness the power of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments. With this investment, you gain a robust framework that is designed for creators like you, who seek to establish their own digital commerce presence.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account to access Pages for hosting. 2. Set up a GitHub repository to manage your code. 3. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend automation. 4. Register for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Develop and prepare your digital products for upload. 6. Integrate NOWPayments API keys into your Google Apps Script. 7. Choose a file delivery method using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 8. Deploy your application on Cloudflare Pages and conduct thorough testing. 9. Promote your store to your audience via social media. 10. Monitor transactions and optimize based on customer feedback.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I really sell digital products without Stripe or PayPal?
Yes, by using the Edge Commerce Stack and NOWPayments, you can sell digital products and process payments in cryptocurrencies without relying on conventional platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse array of customers who prefer different digital currencies.
How do I deliver my products to customers?
You can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery, configuring your backend to automatically send access links to customers upon successful payment.
Is there any ongoing fee after initial setup?
Once you've set up your store with the Edge Commerce Stack, you only incur a 0.5% fee with NOWPayments for each transaction, without any subscription fees.
What kind of support is available after deployment?
When you purchase the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you troubleshoot any issues and optimize your store.
